notes: Minimum setback to the primary and secondary street in metres (A2.3.1). The '2m or nil' cells carry 2; the nil option is the A2.3.1 exception conditioned on building.ground_floor_commercial and table-2.1-street-setback-nil. Extract: '2m | 2m or nil1 | 2m | 2m or nil1 | 2m or nil1' = R80 | LR1 | R100-R160 | MR1-MR2 | HR1-HR3. Rows also match the current names (R-AC4 = LR1, R-AC3 = MR2, R-AC1 = HR1, R-AC0 = R-PA; register C4P2-017). R-AC2 has no column and no row. The generic LR, MR and HR bands have no row (MR and HR each span columns with different values), so a site coded only LR, MR or HR is NOT_APPLICABLE until its code is known.
